pages.text: $(item)Protostar Fragment$(). A piece of a star not yet lit, buried in a nebula's ice. Mined, it gives a Protostellar Ember.
$(thing)Found$(): Inside the Nebula's ice.$(br2)$(thing)Used$(): Gives a Protostellar Ember: thermoelectric fuel that burns for a long time, or feed for the Accretion Disk Reactor.
